title: ci: a weekly merge-queue duration reading against the 22-minute median budget and 32-minute p90 alarm
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ89m6RNA29boJhiBaeXuSSiY)_

Fixes #35322

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: ruled
Ruling-ref: Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-19, review-split discussion thread: 03:16Z 「以上都同意」 (CI speed budget for objectstack; 「变慢两成非常大了」 rejected a 20% allowance); 04:24Z 「1+2+4」, point 2 as amended by the review: budget = median 22 min, alarm = p90 32 min, measured weekly by a script that files a speed-up card when over; a PR's own before/after reading is advisory and never blocks a merge.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增每周一自动量一次合并队列耗时（中位、九成、失败率、最慢的五个作业）；中位超过 22 分钟或九成超过 32 分钟就自动开或刷新唯一一张提速卡；AGENTS.md 加两行预算说明。
- 为什么：落实你 11-19 定的 CI 速度预算。本周实测中位 21.9、九成 31.9 分钟，已贴着上限，没人盯就会悄悄变慢。
- 最坏情况与能否撤回：量错会多开或漏开一张提速卡，不挡任何合并、不碰任何必需检查；删掉这个 workflow 即可撤回。
- 需要你做的：AGENTS.md 的行数上限是 1050，这两行让它到 1052（该门禁现在是红的）——请一句话批准上调 2 行并给出可引用的评论，或指定删哪两行；之后审批合并（改了 workflow 和 AGENTS.md，属人合面）。

## What changes

- **`scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs`** (new, read-only against GitHub). Lists every `merge_group` run created in the window (`--since 7d|24h|ISO`, `--until`), groups by head SHA, and for each SHA whose every queue-workflow run concluded green measures the first run's `created_at` to the last run's `updated_at` (waiting for runners and re-runs included). Prints p50 / p90 / max (nearest rank), the SHA counts (green, red, cancelled, still running), the queue failure rate (SHAs with a red run over completed SHAs), which workflow finished last, and the five slowest jobs of that critical run over an evenly spaced sample of 40 green SHAs. `--repo`, `--json`, `--render FILE`, `--via gh` (a seat whose egress only `gh` reaches). Exit 2 = NOT MEASURED: a window that cannot be listed whole is split in halves down to one hour and then refused, never truncated; a sample under the budget's floor is not judged.
- **`scripts/ci/queue-budget.json`** (new): `budgetMedianMinutes: 22`, `alarmP90Minutes: 32`, `minSample: 20`, the baseline with its window, and the five queue workflows (`CI`, `Governed Surface Guard`, `Lint & Type Check`, `PR-Body Guards`, `Spec Liveness Check`, the five files with a `merge_group:` trigger). Its `note` and the script header say changing a number is the maintainer's call. A `merge_group` workflow not on the list is warned about in the reading, never silently folded in.
- **`.github/workflows/queue-duration-budget.yml`** (new). Weekly, Monday 07:09 UTC, plus `workflow_dispatch`, plus a `pull_request` trigger paths-filtered to its own three files. Job `measure` (`actions: read`, `contents: read`, 20 min): self-tests the module, reads objectstack, reads hotcrm report-only (`continue-on-error`, no card), writes both readings to the run summary, keeps them as an artifact, and reds only on NOT MEASURED (the patrol reporting its own death). Job `file` (`contents: read`, `issues: write`, 10 min) runs only when the verdict is `over`, the event is not `pull_request` and the ref is `main`; it calls `fileQueueCard`: one card, fixed title `merge queue over its speed budget` plus the plain-text body marker `os-queue-duration-budget`, a bounded open-issue scan that refuses rather than files when it cannot establish absence, the oldest match refreshed in place, labels `tooling`, `area:fleet`, `domain:devx`, `priority:p2`, `pm:queue` and issue type Task on create only (the type is its own write, so a refused type costs the type, never the card).
- **Why its own workflow, not a job in `fleet-patrols.yml`:** that file's `pull_request:` paths list is frozen as a set by `scripts/check-platform-checklist-watchdog.mjs`, and a `pull_request` run there exercises every job. Exercising this reading on its own PRs would mean widening the frozen list and editing the pin and its self-test, and every PR touching a sibling patrol's input would then also spend a live queue reading. A separate file leaves the pin untouched and scopes the PR run to this reading. No `merge_group:` and no `pull_request_target:` trigger; not a required context.
- **`.github/workflows/lint.yml`**: one `run_self_test` line in the existing "Moved workflow step bodies self-test" collector, so `Lint & Repo Gates` runs the new self-test on every PR.
- **`AGENTS.md`** Build & Test: two lines stating the budget file, the weekly read, the one speed-up card, and that a CI-changing PR reports its job's before/after median as advisory.

## Why

The maintainer set a CI speed budget for objectstack (Ruling-ref above). Nothing watched the queue's duration trend, so a slower queue was noticed by nobody. A PR's own before/after reading stays advisory: a gate grading a duration reports and never reds a required job (AGENTS.md Build & Test).

## Verification

All readings below are against `objectstack-ai/objectstack`; script at branch commits `fe60502e`..`1397a8ab` (the measuring code unchanged across them), `origin/main` at `a998964d` when the readings were taken.

<details><summary>Self-test: 53 assertions, 8 floored batteries</summary>

`node scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs --self-test` on head `1397a8ab`:

```
✓ queue-duration --self-test: 53 assertions across 8 floored batteries.
```

Batteries: percentile and window parsing (6) · grouping by head SHA (9) · verdict, each threshold alone, sample floor, report-only (6) · listing: the adaptive split, cross-slice de-dup, a failed page fails the listing (5) · critical-run jobs (4) · budget file, the tracked file plus six malformed shapes (7) · the card (10, including the de-dup proof: a second run sees the first run's card, refreshes it and never files a second) · rendering (6). Roster, battery floor and verdict handshake per AGENTS.md "Writing a --self-test".
</details>

<details><summary>Live dry run, last 7 days: p50 21.9 · p90 31.9 · max 55.6 min, WITHIN</summary>

`node scripts/ci/queue-duration.mjs --via gh --since 7d`, window `2026-11-12T04:42:36Z .. 2026-11-19T04:42:36Z`, 165 API reads:

- 10195 runs · 2039 head SHAs · 1802 all-green · 224 red · 12 cancelled · 1 still running
- all-green SHAs: p50 **21.9 min** · p90 **31.9 min** · max 55.6 min, verdict WITHIN (median 21.9 ≤ 22, p90 31.9 ≤ 32)
- queue failure rate: 224 of 2038 completed SHAs had a red run (11.0%)
- the run that finished last: CI on 1801 of 1802 green SHAs
- slowest jobs of that run (median over 40 sampled SHAs): Test Core (9/10) 24 min (3 sampled), Test Core (7/8) 19 min, Test Core (8/8) 18.5 min, Test Core (3/10) 17.3 min, Test Core (3/8) 17.2 min. Both shard spellings appear because the Test Core shard count changed inside the window.

Against the card's baseline window (`--since 2026-11-17T00:00:00Z`, to 2026-11-19T04:39Z): p50 21.6 · p90 31.5 · max 51.3 min over 456 all-green SHAs, against the baseline's 21.7 / 31.9 / 34.5 over 176. The percentiles land within half a minute. The sample size and the max differ, and the baseline's record does not say why its count is 176; this reading counts every all-green SHA in the window, re-runs included by design, and its max is a single SHA.
</details>

<details><summary>hotcrm, report-only</summary>

`--repo objectstack-ai/hotcrm --since 7d`: 46 runs (CI only) · 45 all-green · 1 red · p50 24.1 · p90 40 · max 41.8 min; slowest job `CI / Build and Test (22.x)` 24.1 min. Printed to the run summary only; no card, never judged against the budget.
</details>

<details><summary>Local gates</summary>

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (59 commands; tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack`). On the final head `1397a8ab`: 57 of the 59 run directly, **56 exit 0, 1 exit 1** (below); `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` is the 58th; `pnpm check:type-check-debt` is NOT MEASURED. `dispatch-gates --ran` with every exit code recorded: `59 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.

- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 2249 cases) green on `5b3f27f4`. Its first run, on an earlier head, caught two things this PR then fixed: the new paths-filtered workflow discovered no check family (now the `measure` job's self-test step is its family), and a `no-check-families` marker would have broken the marker census.
- `pnpm check:workflow-status-functions` caught the `file` job's `if:` reading `needs.*.outputs.*` with no status function; it is now `!cancelled() && ...`.
- ⛔ **Red, on purpose, and the one open question:** `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` — `AGENTS.md is 1052 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 1050`. The two lines are the card's item 4. Raising the `CEILINGS` row needs the ruling comment id that orders the text, and this card's ruling lives in a discussion thread with no GitHub comment id, so the row is left at 1050. Both lines fit the 120-byte line budget.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: NOT MEASURED locally (timed out at 300 s on the shared box); the diff touches no package. CI runs it.
- Not run locally, CI-owned: `pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, the type-check lanes.
- `workflow_dispatch`: NOT MEASURED — a dispatch only runs a workflow that is on the default branch. This PR's own `pull_request` run exercises the `measure` job live and writes nothing.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset:** none. Nothing here ships in any package's `files[]` (`scripts/ci/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`), so the PR wants the `skip-changeset` label, which this session could not write.
- The card is filed only on an `over` week. A week back within budget writes nothing, so an open speed-up card is closed by the seat that lands the speed-up, not by this workflow.
- The job wait column (job `created_at` to `started_at`) reads 0 minutes across the sample, so that column does not capture runner waiting on this repository; the waiting is inside each SHA's first-start-to-last-end span, which is what the budget grades.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no formatter ran; `pnpm lint` left to CI)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing; `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [ ] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. (not read by this session)
